pairs: You should not rebuke an old man,
but rather plead with him, as if he were your father;
with young women, in all chastity, like sisters.
viduas honora, quæ vere viduæ sunt.
Honor those widows who are true widows.
But if any widow has children or grandchildren,
aut nepotes habet: discat primum domum suam regere,
let her first learn to manage her own household, and to fulfill,
in turn, her own obligation to her parents;
hoc enim acceptum est coram Deo.
for this is acceptable before God.
Quæ autem vere vidua est, et desolata,
But she who is truly a widow and is destitute,
et instet obsecrationibus, et orationibus nocte ac die.
and let her be urgent in supplications and prayers, night and day.
For she who is living in pleasures is dead,
so that they may be beyond reproach.
But if anyone has no concern for his own,
et maxime domesticorum, curam non habet,
and especially for those of his own household,
and he is worse than an unbeliever.
Vidua eligatur non minus sexaginta annorum,
Let a widow be chosen who is no less than sixty years of age,
who was the wife of one husband,
who has testimony of her good works:
or has washed the feet of the saints,
or has ministered to those suffering tribulation,
si omne opus bonum subsecuta est.
or has pursued any kind of good work.
cum enim luxuriatæ fuerint in Christo,
For once they have flourished in Christ,
because they have disregarded the primacy of faith.
simul autem et otiosæ discunt circuire domos:
And being at the same time also idle,
they learn to go from house to house,
speaking of things which do not concern them.
Therefore, I want the younger women to marry,
nullam occasionem dare adversario maledicti gratia.
to provide no ready opportunity for the adversary to speak evil.
Jam enim quædam conversæ sunt retro Satanam.
For certain ones have already been turned back to Satan.
If any among the faithful have widows,
subministret illis, et non gravetur ecclesia:
let him minister to them and not burden the Church,
ut iis quæ vere viduæ sunt, sufficiat.
so that there may be enough for those who are true widows.
Let priests who lead well be held worthy of twice the honor,
especially those who labor in the Word
maxime qui laborant in verbo et doctrina.
“You shall not muzzle an ox as it is treading out the grain,”
“The worker is worthy of his pay.”
Do not be willing to accept an accusation against a priest,
nisi sub duobus aut tribus testibus.
except under two or three witnesses.
Reprove sinners in the sight of everyone,
so that the others may have fear.
Testor coram Deo et Christo Jesu, et electis angelis,
I testify before God and Christ Jesus and the elect Angels,
that you should observe these things without prejudgment,
nihil faciens in alteram partem declinando.
doing nothing which shows favoritism to either side.
You should not be quick to impose hands on anyone,
nor should you take part in the sins of outsiders.
Do not continue to drink only water,
sed modico vino utere propter stomachum tuum,
but make use of a little wine,
for the sake of your stomach and your frequent infirmities.
The sins of some men have been made manifest,
but those of others are manifested later.
good deeds have been made manifest,
